intent: The editor's bottom timeline region: one playhead shared across a master project strip (seconds) and a slide-local element-animation view (ms), driven entirely by controlled data.
guidance: Holds no document state: drive it with tracks/blocks/clips plus a controlled viewport and playhead, and commit every edit through callbacks. `mode` swaps the whole surface — master (project strip, seconds ruler) vs slide-local (per-property keyframes, ms ruler) — but the playhead is one object; only the time scale changes. Auto-keyframe/record chrome is scoped to slide mode and fails closed in master. The plot spans full-width beneath the right zoom/collapse overlay; the track-header column is a width slot (`trackHeaderWidth`, default 297px). Wire one callback per affordance — an unwired control renders visible-but-disabled, never a silent no-op. Easing is quick-switched from a timeline popover but fully edited in the inspector, not here.

anatomy.description: Left of the header: Play/Pause, Stop, an optional auto-keyframe (record) toggle in slide mode, the current + duration timecode group (ms or seconds), and a Loop toggle.
Center scrub surface: millisecond ticks (slide) or second ticks that fold to m:ss when zoomed out (master), labels centered on the time position.
A triangular handle on the ruler plus a vertical line spanning every lane; recolors red while auto-keyframe/record is armed.
Right-hand absolute overlay: a range slider for time-axis zoom and a collapse/expand-timeline button.
Fixed left column (default 297px) that the transport, lane headers, and every row line up against; a hairline divider marks its right edge.

Master view: Compositions, Video, and Audio rows, each a lane header ([type icon][label][+] over [eye][solo][mute][lock]) beside a track of draggable/trimmable clip bars with optional thumbnails and waveform strips.
Slide view: a "← Project" back row above a listbox of animated-layer rows (disclosure chevron, type icon, name, visibility eye, aggregate keyframes, duration bar).

Slide view, expanded: a name column (prev/add/next keyframe stepper, inline value field, eye) beside a keyframe lane of diamonds, a connecting line, and per-interval easing segments; Animate-preset bars sit above them.
Horizontal draggable thumb at the bottom showing the visible window over the whole duration, offset past the header column.

use_when: Building the editor's bottom timeline: a slide's element keyframe tracks (ms) or the full-project master strip of composition/video/audio clips (seconds).
You need one playhead and viewport shared across a master and a slide-local view, driven by controlled props.
You want draggable/trimmable clip + duration bars and keyframe lanes that emit committed callbacks rather than owning state.
dont_use_when: You only need preset-based animation recipes (Build In / Action / Build Out) — use the Animate inspector tab.
You need the full easing bezier/curve editor with numeric handles — that lives in the inspector, not the timeline.
The surface must own document state, undo, order, or persistence — that stays in the host editor.

mode: master (full-project strip — Compositions/Video/Audio lanes, seconds ruler)
slide (slide-local element animation — layer + property keyframe rows, ms ruler, record chrome)

slots.renderTrackRow: Slide-mode composition seam (DEC-097): override how each track's rows render, receiving the exact TimelineTrackRowsProps the built-in rows get. Omit to use TimelineTrackRows unchanged.

states: recording (auto-keyframe armed — red top accent + red playhead, slide mode only)
lane: dimmed (eye-off or another lane soloed — opacity-40)
lane: locked (bars read-only, no trim handles)

type.label: text-[11px]
type.weight: font-[450] default, font-[550] selected track, font-[650] solo “S”

tokens.note: Hardcoded hex/rgba literals exist — #8638e5 (accented property track line, diamond fill, name), #ff3b30 (auto-keyframe/record top accent + playhead), and rgba(0,0,0,0.25) (legacy numeric-keyframe connecting line). The selection accent is the token var(--color-border-selected). Because #hex literals exist, tokensOnly is not asserted.

a11y.role: No landmark role on the root region; interactive parts carry their own roles. Playhead is role="slider" (always rendered); the slide-local layer list is role="listbox" aria-multiselectable with role="option" rows.
a11y.playhead: role=slider, aria-label "Playhead", aria-valuemin/max/now in ms; Arrow/Home/End scrub, Space toggles play, plus K (add keyframe) and Delete/Backspace in slide mode when wired.
a11y.layers: Roving tabindex across role=option rows; Arrow/Home/End move focus, Enter/Space select, Arrow Left/Right collapse/expand.
a11y.scrollbar: Horizontal time scrollbar is role=scrollbar aria-orientation=horizontal with aria-valuemin/max/now.
a11y.bars: Composition/clip bars are role=button with aria-pressed and aria-haspopup for their context menu; trim handles are role=slider; every icon control has an aria-label mirrored by its hover tooltip.

code.example:
<Timeline
  mode="slide"
  tracks={tracks}
  playhead={timeMs}
  onPlayheadChange={(ms) => setTime(ms)}
  onKeyframeSelect={(t) => select(t)}
  onKeyframeMove={(t, ms) => moveKeyframe(t, ms)}
  autoKeyframe={recording}
  onAutoKeyframeChange={setRecording}
  onBack={exitSlide}
/>
